conclusion: Retain three local reductions of confirmed redundant work; no stable overall speedup, equivalence, isolated layout causality or full residual root cause established. Hyle remains slower in this fixed trace.
changes: Cache fixed transport owner only inside private session validation; all27400 runtime owner/lifecycle/cancellation/deadline checks retained. Public owner_worker getters unchanged, including zero after shutdown.

Count whole owner-side predicate waits; notify_owner still advances change_epoch but calls CV only if owner_waiters nonzero. Foreign cancellation still locks monitor and unconditionally notifies; counter not read by foreign thread.

Empty flush with no encoded or owned wire data releases unobservable temporary write claim without artificial change publication. Registered close/error callbacks publish their own changes; real frames retain normal release notifications.
